Name: Media Control for D200
Description: Local macOS media display and controls with automatic D200 bridge startup
Detail: Media Control for D200 connects the Ulanzi D200 desktop controller to local macOS media status and transport controls. It can show now-playing artwork, title, artist, playback state, track progress, and macOS output volume or mute state on D200 keys and the center display. The plugin starts its local companion bridge from the plugin package and is intended for macOS 13 or later with Ulanzi Deck 2.1.4 or later.
